run_tokenize_cpp_source: run the C++ tokenizer on a source file to print all tokens with their types
create_token_instance: create a Token object with a token type, name, start index, and end index
get_tokens_from_source: get a sequence of Token objects by passing C++ source code to GetTokens
review_GetString_helper: review the _GetString helper function that finds the end of C++ string literals
summarize_token_types: summarize the token type constants UNKNOWN, SYNTAX, CONSTANT, NAME, and PREPROCESSOR
